name: Summon Fiend
description: Summon an allied Fiendish Spirit in an open space you can see, choosing Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth to determine its stat-block features. It shares your Initiative and acts immediately after you, follows verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. **Higher-Level Slots.** The stat block uses the slot level as the spell level.
